package.description: Screen recorder with automatic zoom, cursor focus and local editing.

en-US.description: Screen recorder with automatic zoom, cursor focus and local editing.
en-US.longDescription: Record product demos and tutorials with automatic zoom, cursor focus and local editing on Windows and Mac. Click to Reel records a display, window, or selected area with GPU acceleration, lets the camera follow important actions without keyframes, and offers light timeline editing: split clips, remove segments, adjust speed, and add a background before exporting a video ready to share. Recording and export up to 1080P are free.
en-US.name: Click to Reel

zh-CN.longDescription: 用 Click to Reel 录制产品演示和教程，自动缩放、光标聚焦与本地剪辑一体完成，支持 Windows 和 Mac。可选择屏幕、窗口或区域开始录制，GPU 加速录制与导出；镜头自动跟随关键操作，无需逐帧调整，还可在时间线上修剪片段、调整速度并添加背景，直接导出可分享的视频。录制与导出 480P、720P 和 1080P 视频免费。
